user.title: Choose a phone
user.description: Choose the phone whose alarms this routine should follow. If a phone isn't listed, turn on its Next alarm sensor in the Home Assistant Android app, under Settings, Companion app, Manage sensors. Make sure that sensor's Allow list is off.

error.no_tracker: This phone's location entity is turned off or missing in Home Assistant. Go to Settings, Devices & services, Entities, and set the Status filter to show Disabled. Find the device tracker named after this phone and turn it on. If it isn't there, restart Home Assistant. Then add the routine again.
error.phone_gone: That phone's Next alarm sensor was turned off. Turn it back on in the Home Assistant Android app. Then close this form and add the routine again.

abort.already_configured: This phone already has a morning routine.
abort.no_phones: No phones with a Next alarm sensor were found. Turn on the Next alarm sensor in the Home Assistant Android app, under Settings, Companion app, Manage sensors. Make sure that sensor's Allow list is off. Then add the routine again.

data.require_zero_seconds: Only follow alarms set to a whole minute

data_description.require_zero_seconds: Alarms you set yourself have 00 seconds. Some phone entries that aren't alarms don't. Leave this on to skip them.

clock_not_found.message: {clock} isn't one of the clocks this phone offers.

entry_not_found.message: No morning routine has that config entry id.

entry_not_loaded.message: That morning routine isn't running. Check that it is loaded in Settings, Devices & services.

invalid_step.message: Step {number} must have an item (text) and offset_minutes (a whole number), and may have enabled (true or false). Nothing else is allowed.

item_not_allowed.message: {item} can't be a step. It must be a script, scene or automation that has the label "morning routine".

duplicate_item.message: {item} is listed twice. Each item can be a step once.

offset_out_of_range.message: The offset for {item} must be a whole number of minutes from -{limit} to {limit}.

set_steps.name: Set steps
set_steps.description: Replaces all the steps of one morning routine. This is temporary, until the card can edit steps. Only administrators can use it.

config_entry_id.name: Morning routine
config_entry_id.description: The routine whose steps are replaced.

steps.name: Steps
steps.description: A list. Each step has an item (a script, scene or automation with the label "morning routine"), offset_minutes (-720 to 720, negative is before the alarm), and optionally enabled (true or false, default true).
